{{Nihongo|Barney|バータル|Bātaru}} is a villager in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]].''

The happy clown and ringmaster, Barney runs the local circus with his wife [[Mimi (DS)|Mimi]]. The couple will move in after your child is born, and spend most of their time in the circus tent. Barney leaves the tent on Tuesdays.

The circus grounds are located next to the spring in the south eastern part of town. You can talk to and befriend both Mimi and Barney, but the circus itself will never actually open.
